text: “Well, doctor, decide our fate,” said the princess. “Tell me everything.” “Is there hope?” she meant to say, but her lips quivered, and she could not utter the question. “Well, doctor?” “Immediately, princess. I will talk it over with my colleague, and then I will have the honor of laying my opinion before you.” “So we had better leave you?” “As you please.” The princess went out with a sigh. When the doctors were left alone, the family doctor began timidly explaining his opinion, that there was a commencement of tuberculous trouble, but ... and so on.
